statement: Totality and exactness use the stated small-category, covariant-action, and integral-module conventions.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label A:conventions; work/part_a.tex; PDF p. 1
notes: Definitions and variance.

statement: Every nonempty connected total small category has exact abelian colimits.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label A:main; work/part_a.tex; PDF p. 1
notes: No proof or counterexample is asserted. The smallest unresolved ordinary family is a triple.

statement: For any small category, integral exactness is equivalent to exactness over Q and every F_p jointly.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label A:fields; work/part_a.tex; PDF p. 2
notes: Empty and disconnected categories included. No individual total-to-field-exact implication is settled.

statement: The resolving class generated by permutation diagrams is colimit-acyclic under totality and already closed under tensoring with permutation diagrams.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label A:closure; work/part_a.tex; PDF p. 3
depends_on: R1; exactness of tensoring with a pointwise free diagram
notes: Does not assert closure under arbitrary images or cokernels.

statement: The column obstruction modules, or the augmentation multiplication image I(M)^2, belong to the proved resolving class.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label A:membership; work/part_a.tex; PDF p. 3
notes: This unproved membership step is not used as an inference.

statement: Every triple of ordinary parallel arrows in every total category has an affine equalizer.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label B:triple; work/part_b.tex; PDF p. 3
notes: Exact remaining obstruction is T_1(Q_a)=Z/epsilon(L).

statement: Lead 1: under totality, T_1(P_q/(K_1+K_2)) is canonically Z/epsilon(K_1 intersection K_2).
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label B:lead1; work/part_b.tex; PDF p. 4
notes: Includes the explicit natural alternative quotient isomorphism and pair-kernel acyclicity.

statement: Lead 2: under I, exactness is equivalent to affine annihilation of every augmentation-zero arrow combination; the one-relator Tor formula needs no hypothesis on A.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label B:lead2; work/part_b.tex; PDF p. 5
notes: Includes empty/disconnected categories and zero combinations.

statement: Lead 3: for arbitrary small A, the column module has the stated canonical derived-colimit groups; with common successors T_1=0 detects affine equalization.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label B:lead3; work/part_b.tex; PDF p. 5
notes: Includes k=0 and keeps the permutation row cokernel distinct from the column cokernel.

statement: Lead 4: quasi-filteredness equalizes same-set-colimit elements affinely; under I, exactness is equivalent to doing so for same-abelian-colimit elements.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label B:lead4; work/part_b.tex; PDF p. 6
notes: The exact instance of Proposition 2.3 is proved directly.

statement: The set-to-abelian colimit map is surjective under connectedness and common successors; exactness implies neither its injectivity nor finite-product preservation by set colimits.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label B:lead4-qualification; work/part_b.tex; PDF p. 6
notes: Stronger readings of Lead 4 are refuted by explicit Delta_inj vectors and an affine equality.

statement: Lead 5(i)-(iv): the kappa identity, finite parallel-difference form, affine-annihilation implication, kernel of psi, and mixed-cycle Tor formula hold.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label B:lead5; work/part_b.tex; PDF p. 7
notes: The one-term consequence uses IV. The geometric cycle is interpreted with coefficients.

statement: The mixed-cycle quotient has the same positive derived-group formulas as Q_a; its distinguished Tor class has connecting image kappa.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label B:mixed-cycle; work/part_b.tex; PDF p. 8
notes: No isomorphism of the two coefficient diagrams and no nonzero ordinary H_1(BA) is claimed.

statement: Every spherical homotopy class in a category nerve is represented by a functor from the face poset of a finite triangulated sphere.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:finite-nerve; work/part_c_leads.tex; PDF p. 9
notes: Uses the boundary of an ordered simplex and finite Ex-stage factorization.

statement: Lead 6: totality is equivalent to componentwise nullhomotopy of every comprehensive-factorization test j_u from a finite poset; sphere face posets suffice.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:lead6; work/part_c_leads.tex; PDF p. 9
notes: The comparison natural transformation and literal factorization are specified.

statement: Lead 7: under the stated contractible-comma hypothesis, the link comparison is a weak equivalence and attachments cannot kill homology above the diagram dimension.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:lead7; work/part_c_leads.tex; PDF p. 10
depends_on: Quillen Theorem A; relative nerve chains
notes: Works for arbitrary, possibly noninjective, set actions.

statement: A quasi-filter necklace with fc=gc has a noncontractible comma component; the hypothesis of Lead 7 fails for allowed later AKR attachments.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:lead7-limitation; work/part_c_leads.tex; PDF p. 11
notes: A graph circle cannot be filled by a degree-two boundary in that comma category.

statement: Lead 8: Ty^op is the weakly increasing sign-word category and fails I and IV; its two specified arrows have no affine equalizer over any nonzero commutative ring.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:lead8; work/part_c_leads.tex; PDF p. 11
notes: The infinite-category proof is analytical; finite checks are supplementary.

statement: Lead 9(a)-(d): a minimal bad family has no return arrow, unbounded representable values, survives the source cosieve, and remains pairwise distinct under every postcomposition.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:lead9; work/part_c_leads.tex; PDF p. 12
notes: Global minimality of family length is used in (d).

statement: The repaired AKR construction satisfies the categorical two-point factorization and incidence expansion bounds of Theorem C.2.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:akr-invariant; work/part_c_akr_checked.tex; PDF p. 13
notes: The full published induction was checked; two additional index misprints are corrected.

statement: For every nonzero commutative ring R, the AKR column is pointwise split injective with free cokernel Q and L_1 colim Q=R, L_i colim Q=0 for i>=2.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:akr-split-column; work/part_c_akr_checked.tex; PDF p. 14
notes: No natural splitting or inference of non-totality is made.

statement: Every admissible repaired AKR completion has nonzero H_2 for the specified pair-quotient element category.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:all-stage; work/part_c.tex; PDF p. 15
notes: Initial class and full-second-stage injection do not prove persistence through the union.

statement: Six specified admissible second-stage targets pass all 69,768 generating-pair component tests and all reversed-action tests.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:component-probe; work/part_c.tex; PDF p. 15
notes: Finite scope only. No complete later stage or arbitrary attachment is covered.

statement: The finite-family Ramsey property has the explicit coloring quantifiers stated in the paper.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:ramsey-definition; work/ramsey_exact.tex; PDF p. 15
notes: Adopted convention; not an assertion about total categories.

statement: Common successors plus the finite-family Ramsey property imply integral condition III; adding I gives exactness.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label thm:ramsey-exact; work/ramsey_exact.tex; PDF p. 15
notes: The proof handles proper augmentation ideals dZ, including d=0.

statement: Finite ordered graphs and ordered triangle-free graphs with induced embeddings are exact and total, and are not filtered.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label cor:ordered-graphs-exact; work/ramsey_exact.tex; PDF p. 16
notes: Closes the two named candidates in route C4; coefficients may be changed from Z.

statement: Totality implies the finite-family Ramsey property needed by the sufficient condition.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label C:ramsey-scope; work/ramsey_exact.tex; PDF p. 17
notes: This implication was not proved and is not assumed.

statement: Filtered is properly contained in exact, which is contained in total, which is contained in quasi-filtered; exact and quasi-filtered differ.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label D:class-diagram; work/manuscript_audit.tex; PDF p. 17
notes: The two adjacent comparisons involving totality remain undecided separately.

statement: Grothendieck's total-to-filtered conjecture is false; total plus siftedness or the stated fixed positive truncation condition implies filteredness.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label D:manuscript-II; work/manuscript_audit.tex; PDF p. 18
notes: The conjecture is refuted; the additional-hypothesis repairs are proved and known.

statement: Homotopy colimits preserve a fixed finite positive truncation level exactly when the stated groupoid-completion comma categories are filtered.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label D:positive-truncation-record; work/manuscript_audit.tex; PDF p. 19
notes: The cover comparison and all variance data are recorded; no novelty claim.

statement: The II and XII displayed formulas require the two specified type corrections; XII's presheaf and category quantifiers are distinct.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label D:manuscript-types; work/manuscript_audit.tex; PDF p. 20
notes: Corrects y\Y to y\X and U/H' to U'/H'; preserves presheaf variance.

statement: The source audit records exact opened passages and unsuccessful retrieval routes for every requested literature line.
where_proved: TOTEX2_paper.tex, label D:source-record; work/part_d.tex; source_audit.tex; PDF p. 21
notes: Unobtained mathematical bodies are not described as opened.
